caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is rarely a matter of simple gears. Up in the high cloud forests, the clay has its own gravity, and some slopes are meant to be walked, bike on shoulder, while the mist settles over the ridge. This is the reality of the mountain terrain: it demands respect, patience, and a willingness to slow down when the earth asks you to. There are no crowds here, no pavement, and no easy shortcuts—just the quiet work of your own legs against the mountain.
